On phones the Getting started block sits ABOVE the dawn instead (the composer stays at the bottom). The brand-mark watermark and the three suggestion rows are GONE (composer-menu.json). Greeting = pure `homeGreeting(local, name)` (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/home-greeting.ts, mirrored by desktop crates/ui home_greeting, iOS ExpCore HomeGreeting.swift, Android domain/HomeGreeting.kt; every mirror replays `cases`): `local` = the device's local wall-clock time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`; the BUCKET comes from the hour (`from`..`to` inclusive, night wraps midnight); the VARIANT = dayIndex mod the bucket's length, where dayIndex = whole days from 1970-01-01 to the local date of (`local` minus `dayStartsAtHour` hours), so one night keeps one greeting across midnight and a new one starts at 05:00; `{name}` = the first whitespace-separated token of the user row's name, and with no name the `, {name}` segment is dropped (`Back at it`, `What's next?`). The greeting is computed once per page mount (it never flips while you type). Review #16: `{name}` is replaced literally (no replacement patterns).

agentRow.$comment: S-3 (owner 2026-10-28): THE AGENT ROW on the New-chat composer ×4 (web agent home + New session tab, IDE Agent page, iOS + Android Agent tab), styleguide entry `composer-agent-row` (Exponential-specific: NOT an Exponential UI primitive). It stands directly ABOVE the composer card, `rowToCard` px over it, with the LABEL line `labelToRow` px over the circles (left-aligned with the card, the muted small text: `copy.to` with the picked agent's name, or `copy.temporary`). The circles = SINGLE SELECT, left to right: the viewer's Assistant (agent-settings.json `orderedAgents`: first, the brand mark), then the team agents they see (agent icon in its colour), then ONE dotted circle (concept `temporaryIcon`, the muted foreground; NEVER status-backlog) = Temporary session, a normal session. Each circle = the chats.json agent BUBBLE at `size` px (the same disc on bg muted, the same `ringGap` background gap; no name under it, the name is the label and the tooltip / accessibility label); the SELECTED circle wears the foreground ring (`ringWidth`), the others the glass-stroke hairline. A tap selects (tapping the selected circle keeps it: it is never empty); the row scrolls horizontally when it overflows. DEFAULT (`defaultPick`): the Assistant when the viewer has one, else Temporary session; a page mount starts on it again. SEEDED (`seedCases`): a page opened WITH a subject (a start circle / Start chipping an issue, a prompt run, a device seed) starts on Temporary session, so the send is a normal launch with that subject, never a message to the Assistant. SUBJECT SWITCH (`subjectCases`): picking an issue or a prompt afterwards moves the row to Temporary session; any other subject change keeps the pick; tapping an agent afterwards picks it (the last tap wins). Picking an agent hides the + menu's runner and work rows (composer-menu.json: `temporary` false) and the send = `sessions.send({agentId, text, attachmentIds})` into the viewer's conversation with that agent, which the client then opens (its chat, chats.json chat mode); Temporary session = today's launch (device, account, model, repository, work picks in the +).
